explanation: The ui-change route keeps both changes: what a Compare column says about a gene, including per-arm n, mean and SEM, comes from src/compare/compareCell.ts (catalog compare entry references it), and from main the study-selection module (studySelectionLink.ts in the router, StudySelectionPanel in both reports) plus static study pages rendering the study publication record.
